description: Curated table of hardening settings known to break common website features. Each entry maps a chrome.privacy API + value to a list of typical breakage symptoms and the kind of sites usually affected. Used by the Health diagnose modal to suggest which setting to revert when a user reports a website not working.

symptom.es: Rompe SSO, players embebidos (Vimeo en Notion, Twitch embed) y carritos de compra que usan cookies de terceros para sesión
symptom.en: Breaks SSO, embedded players (Vimeo in Notion, Twitch embed) and shopping carts using third-party cookies for session

symptom.es: Rompe videollamadas: Discord, Google Meet, Microsoft Teams, WhatsApp Web, Zoom Web
symptom.en: Breaks video calls: Discord, Google Meet, Microsoft Teams, WhatsApp Web, Zoom Web

symptom.es: Puede romper redes corporativas con DNS interno (intranets, recursos en VPN sin DNS público)
symptom.en: May break corporate networks with internal DNS (intranets, VPN-only resources)

symptom.es: Rompe pasarelas de pago, CDN con protección de hotlink y algunos analíticos esenciales
symptom.en: Breaks payment gateways, CDNs with hotlink protection, and some essential analytics

symptom.es: Rompe contenido DRM: Netflix, Spotify Web, HBO, Disney+, Apple TV+, Amazon Prime Video
symptom.en: Breaks DRM content: Netflix, Spotify Web, HBO, Disney+, Apple TV+, Amazon Prime Video

symptom.es: Rompe ping de algunos enlaces de email tracking y métricas de click-through
symptom.en: Breaks ping for some email tracking links and click-through metrics

symptom.es: No suele romper nada visible; puede ralentizar la primera carga de páginas con muchos recursos
symptom.en: Does not usually break anything visible; can slow first load on pages with many resources

symptom.es: Las páginas de error son más austeras pero no rompe ninguna web
symptom.en: Error pages are more austere but does not break any website

symptom.es: No rompe ninguna web; solo desactiva el autocompletado de tarjetas de crédito
symptom.en: Does not break any website; only disables credit card autofill

symptom.es: No rompe webs; solo desactiva la oferta de Chrome de guardar contraseñas
symptom.en: Does not break websites; only disables Chrome's password save prompt

symptom.es: No rompe webs; solo desactiva sugerencias en la barra de direcciones
symptom.en: Does not break websites; only disables address bar suggestions
